contracts.consumer: scoped observation review and records identity decision
contracts.intent: explicit admission and parsing of retained bytes
contracts.terminal_evidence: canonical ParseResult and same-target persisted Observation relationships
contracts.consumer_wording: parse history is separate from accepted identity
contracts.reconciliation: newer failed parser attempt does not demote an earlier successful version
negative_cases: failed parse has no canonical result

contracts.intent: explicit fixed service selection and approval
contracts.terminal_evidence: immutable same-target ordered lines, amount and current actionability
contracts.artifacts: exact approved envelope digest and bytes
contracts.packaging: claim revision detail and approval form
contracts.consumer_wording: historical approval is not current dispatch authority
contracts.reconciliation: service/policy changes block current actionability without erasing history
negative_cases: cross-organization or wrong-claim target fails closed

contracts.consumer: independent receiver observation and operator detail
contracts.terminal_evidence: independent exact-key/bytes receiver observation, not send success
contracts.packaging: delivery effect state, history and actions
contracts.consumer_wording: pending, unsent, unknown, rejected, accepted and conflict stay distinct
contracts.reconciliation: historical readback does not grant retry permission or replace accepted history
negative_cases: unknown receiver effect cannot be cancelled

contracts.intent: explicit lifecycle acceptance or remittance posting
contracts.terminal_evidence: exact candidate attribution, immutable event and complete conserved posting entries
contracts.artifacts: verified retained inbound bytes and semantic digest
contracts.consumer_wording: acknowledgment, credit, liability and cash are separate
contracts.reconciliation: current artifact/conflict alerts never overwrite accepted historical facts
negative_cases: overallocated line rolls back full event/batch

contracts.producer: coherent owner projection capture and archive worker
contracts.consumer: independent item readback and archive lag detail
contracts.terminal_evidence: independent exact projection identity and bytes readback
contracts.artifacts: immutable projection bytes, digest and length
contracts.packaging: per-item history/confirmation separate from current lag
contracts.consumer_wording: send success is unknown until readback; old confirmation is not current export
contracts.reconciliation: readback can confirm a historical unknown without rewriting its outcome

contracts.consumer: planned read-only exception sections and exact detail links
contracts.intent: read only, no new command authorization
contracts.attempt: independently observed read windows, no persisted attempts
contracts.terminal_evidence: not implemented; exact-target helper feature tests required by admission
contracts.consumer_wording: no coherent global page or whole-family-clear inference
contracts.reconciliation: historical facts separate from current alerts and independent observation times
negative_cases: GET must create no observation/evidence rows
